QUOTE: `extern/` holds llama.cpp as a git submodule. `extern/CMakeLists.txt` says external deps are fetched at configure time via FetchContent, and that llama.cpp is "a submodule but NOT built in v1.8.0".
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states llama.cpp is a git submodule under `extern/` and that release notes bump `extern/llama.cpp`, which gives the mechanism and location the item requires.
